protocol.input_values: A=((i%23)-11)/8, B=(((i*7)%19)-9)/32; clamp exercises negative, in-range and >1 branches
protocol.timer: CLOCK_MONOTONIC; per-call mean within external process; first worker initialization included
protocol.oracle: Formula per element; long-double sum oracle; every timed process validates outside timer
protocol.bootstrap: 5000 paired complete-round percentile resamples; seed shared with collection; n>=15
protocol.gcc_baseline: Original source -O3 -ftree-parallelize-loops=p; identical compiler to original and pipeline; flag is not proof of actual parallelization
limitations: Controlled authored corpus; convenience selection, no population inference.
Development/test split is fixed but author designed both; not an untouched external benchmark.
Correctness applies to deterministic tested inputs; not a proof, race detector, or runtime restrict check.
Bootstrap assumes sufficient stationarity; does not establish between-session reproducibility.
